description: New businesses require reliable power, broadband, and infrastructure to locate in rural areas—amenities communities struggle to provide when funding declines and anchor employers shut down. Fortunately, while coal may be retiring, advanced energy systems, like nuclear, paired with emerging high-tech industries offer a new path forward.
paid_for_by: Paid for by Conservatives for Carbone
title: Advanced nuclear reactors and data centers support rural economic development - Michael Carbone for Arizona State House
